implementation.method: inject an ndarray Ritz vector into one Symmray Z2 charge block, reshape it as the two-site tensor, contract it through the effective MPO/environment tensor network, and extract the same output charge block
implementation.scope: open-boundary two-site DMRG with real Hermitian local operator

penaltyComparatorRetyping.interpretation: the exact-sector variational gap has crossed below the penalty-sector value, so the latter is an independent comparator, not a target, upper bound or lower bound

established: The full 24-channel joined Leech rotor can be optimized in exact parity sectors through cutoff two and bond 32 without materializing its local effective Hamiltonian. Three exact controls and the full cutoff-one checkpoint reproduce prior results.
boundary: The bond-24 to bond-32 correction is 0.0957 percent and two more bond-32 sweeps still shift the gap by 7.13e-5 relatively. The global convergence flag is false and no lower enclosure exists; this removes an architecture obstruction but does not certify the gap.
epistemicStatus: verified non-materialized exact-sector carrier solver; cutoff-two spectrum remains quantitatively unconverged
